name: The Creature in My House
source:
After a panda experienced heartbreak, a monster unexpectedly appeared in his house, yet this creature seemed to have no intention of hurting him...

[From [url=https://ghostrickfrost.itch.io/the-creature-in-my-house]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一只熊猫经历失恋心碎之后，他家里突然冒出了一只怪物——然而这个生物似乎并无伤害他的打算……

[摘自[url=https://ghostrickfrost.itch.io/the-creature-in-my-house]Itch.io[/url]]
